meta.title: Balance monitor + image backfill
meta.description: Pick a provider type (Sub2Api / Other) on the Models settings cards. Sub2Api reports quota, rate multiplier and models, and computes spend from the multiplier. Models that declare no input modality get image input backfilled, so a newly added custom provider needs no per-model clicking. Also pins a live-session rail above the workspace list and badges collapsed workspaces that still have running or waiting conversations.
